notes:
Summary: Amberline is evaluating Redwood Dedicated to replace a fragmented self-hosted GPU pool. Primary drivers: consistent sub-50ms p99 latency for serving embeddings and reranking inside RTB pipeline, and predictable unit cost per token under heavy peak patterns.

POC & technical priorities:
- POC scope: 2-week perf/runbook test: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved slice), replay production traffic (peak 6k qps) to validate autoscaling, prefix cache behavior and KV eviction.
- Latency targets: 99th <= 50ms for short chat/rerank paths; 95th <= 30ms for embedding retrieval calls. Throughput target: sustain 4k concurrent streams with backpressure windowing.
- Availability SLO ask: 99.95% monthly for Dedicated; need explicit failover policy (route to hosted or smaller model) in SLA. Legal team flagged data residency clause.

Cost modeling notes (from AE/SE workshop):
- Commit options modeled: 8 / 16 / 32 GPU-months. Baseline internal runs show 62% avg token-utilization at 8-GPU commit during business hours; peak bursts hit 90% for 4 hours/day.
- Redwood pricing assumptions plugged in: committed discount scale ~25% @16, 38% @32 relative to on-demand. SE ran unit economics: with current batch and cache settings, effective cost-per-token ~ $0.000004 at 16GPU commit, $0.0000035 at 32GPU commit (est).
- Amberline asks for a 'utilization floor' credit (if usage < 50% for a month, pro-rata credit) — negotiating.

Technical nuances and risks:
- Model preferences: will start with a quantized open LLM (7B) for rerank, fall back to larger proprietary model for high-value creative ops. Runtime must support mixed-model routing + automatic kernel selection.
- Network: private VPC peering required, egress caps and encryption in transit, KMS integration mandatory. On-prem option still under evaluation for EU ad clients.
- Acceptance criteria for procurement: reproduce p99 latency under replay, show token unit-cost within quoted band, pass security questionnaire (attestation).

- 2026-01-12: Intro call (AE Riley) — Amberline ops outlined latency pain, asked about reserved planning.
- 2026-01-26: SE deep-dive (Priya) — collected RTB qps histograms, model types, KV cache expectations. Drive: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf shared.

- 2026-02-18: Legal & Security intake; Amberline security sent SOC2 checklist and asked for encryption/KMS detail. Ticket SEC-1982 opened.

- AE to circulate a term sheet with 3 commit tiers and proposed utilization-credit language by 2026-02-28.

- Clear SLA on failover routes and compensation.
